inventory.answer: Member of the municipal council of Givry
Politician involved in local politics for several years
Advocate for rural development and environmental issues
Champion of the community of Marvejols (per Mayor Pierre Roussel)
Implementer of national policies at the local level
Participant in municipal council meetings and decisions
First woman to hold the position of Prefect of Lozère
Minister of the Interior (implied context of appointment)

decision.explanation: The question asks for positions held. Document D1 explicitly states Florence Bagnard was appointed 'Prefect of Lozère' and describes her duties. Document D2 explicitly states she 'currently holds the position of conseiller municipal de Givry'. Other candidates like 'First female Prefect' (C2/C14) describe an attribute of the position rather than the position itself, while others (C5-C13, C15-C20) describe roles, attributes, or activities rather than formal titles. 'Resident of Givry' (C4) is a status, not a position. 'Minister of the Interior' (C21) refers to Gérald Darmanin, not Bagnard. The two accepted answers represent the distinct formal positions attributed to her in the source texts.
